notes.title: Space Trains Supports Saving and Scores
notes.content:
Major changes:
[list]
[*]Space Trains now automatically saves your progress when closed.
[*]Once you've beaten the game, you'll have access to a high scores menu.
[/list]

Minor changes:
[list]
[*] Changed the distribution of Desert planets at the start of the game, primarily to prevent uncommon cases where the tutorial is unusually hard.
[*] Now tracking data needed for a future update that shows your progress on discovering all the game's secrets.
[*] Completed runs now save enough data to show a replay of your game. Let me know if you want this.
[*] Seeded runs are now possible. Again, let me know if you want this.
[/list]
